title: Where the Paris 2024 opening ceremony unfolded
description: Five Seine-side sites that anchored the first Olympic opening staged outside a stadium, 26 July 2024.

markers.label: Pont d'Austerlitz
markers.note: Start line where the 85-boat athletes' parade entered the Seine.

markers.label: Notre-Dame de Paris
markers.note: The flotilla passed the cathedral, still under post-fire restoration.

markers.label: Louvre riverfront
markers.note: Tableau staged on the quays beside the museum's Right Bank facade.

markers.label: Pont Alexandre III
markers.note: Protocol hub where flags were raised and the parade concluded.

markers.label: Eiffel Tower / Trocadéro
markers.note: Finale site where the Olympic flame was lit before a global broadcast.
